trello.name: Sign venue contract and confirm AV recording
trello.desc: Diego to get the convention center contract through legal review and signed by end of next week. Must confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall plus two breakouts), not main-hall only as happened last year.

trello.name: Lock speaker lineup to nine confirmed
trello.desc: Bo to send final follow-ups to the two maybe speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either declines, fill from the backup list of five names. Commitment is to have the full lineup of nine speakers locked within two weeks so the agenda can be printed.

trello.name: Obtain keynote abstract from Dr. Osei
trello.desc: Bo to chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract this week. The abstract is needed for the website and the printed program.

trello.name: Draft and send three-wave email marketing campaign
trello.desc: Diego to draft all three email waves this month. Wave 1: agenda announcement when Bo locks the lineup, sent the day the agenda is live. Wave 2: early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change. Wave 3: final-week push. Registration is currently at 340 against a target of 600.

trello.name: Hand off speaker bios and headshots for website
trello.desc: Bo to hand speaker bios and headshots straight to Diego the same day the lineup locks, so Diego can update the speaker pages on the landing page before the first email wave goes out.

trello.name: Approve swag design proofs and place order
trello.desc: Camille to review the swag design proofs in the shared drive today. Once Camille approves, Diego to place the order this week for 800 shirts across sizes, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers (approximately 9,200 with rush buffer). Lead time was six weeks last year, so this is time-sensitive.
